name: Browserless
description: Browserless runs headless Chromium as a service that Puppeteer and Playwright scripts connect to over a WebSocket. Its REST API turns a URL or HTML into screenshots, PDFs, rendered content or scraped data and runs custom functions, and a built-in debugger lets you write and test scripts in the browser.

notes.text: Every request needs the token: ws://<IP>:3000?token=<TOKEN> for Puppeteer and Playwright, ?token=<TOKEN> on REST calls and the debugger. It is TOKEN in /opt/browserless_data/.env.
Browserless is licensed under SSPL-1.0. Using it for commercial or closed-source software requires a commercial licence from browserless.io.

app_vars.name: var_browserless_token
app_vars.label: API Token
app_vars.help: Optional. Left empty, a random 32-character token is generated
